paragraphs.text: Ace & Co. hosts Pontotoc’s next Mahjong on Main game Tuesday, Dec. 1. The Chamber’s registration flyer gives the session 16 spots. One day later, on Wednesday, Dec. 2, registration opens for the next game, Jan. 5 at The Rack.

The December host is at 11 W. Marion St. in Pontotoc. Registration opened Nov. 9. The flyer gives the seat limit but does not list how many seats remain or a starting time. Anyone planning to go can check with Ace & Co. at 662-419-3232.

For players who miss the January session, the calendar also lists a Feb. 2 game at The Carousel. Its registration opens Jan. 6. The Chamber gives each of those sessions the same 16-player limit as the December game.
